# ItalyInCountry

> Your in-country partner in Italy. Employer of Record (EOR) in Italy: €250 per employee per month, all inclusive. Invoiced in the client's currency at the EUR reference rate.

## Pages
- [Data Exchange](https://italyincountry.com/data-exchange.html): Monthly input file spec and payroll outputs for platforms: CSV and JSON fields, payroll register, GL journal, payslips and F24 summary.
- [Partner Enquiry](https://italyincountry.com/contact.html): Partner enquiry for EOR and payroll platforms that need an in-country employer in Italy.
- [Partner Onboarding](https://italyincountry.com/onboarding.html): How platforms start working with ItalyInCountry: from first call to the first payroll run in Italy.
- [Partner Pricing](https://italyincountry.com/pricing.html): Wholesale in-country employer of record pricing for platforms: from €100 per employee per month, employment cost on actuals.
- [Partner Program](https://italyincountry.com/partner-program.html): Partner program for payroll bureaus, global mobility advisors, HR consultants and law firms that serve EOR platforms and multinational clients in Italy.
- [Service Levels](https://italyincountry.com/service-levels.html): Onboarding times, payroll cut-off and response times for platforms using ItalyInCountry as their Italian partner.

- [Year-End Readiness Checklist for Italian ICP Operations](https://italyincountry.com/articles/year-end-readiness-checklist-italian-icp-operations.html): A practical checklist for EOR and payroll platforms running Italian ICP operations through year-end payroll, the extra monthly salary and new-year recalculations.
